content: Asleep? I thought that you had to take an exam.
I was sick. I had a fever. I couldn't get out of bed.
You still look a little sick. You couldn't go back to bed.
I'm going now. I just came here to speak to my professor.
Oh, what did he tell you?
He said that I'd be able to take a make up.
Well, that's alright then. Are you going straight home?
I have to stop at the drug store on the way. I need some medicine.
Do you think you should walk that far?
I have to walk. I didn't drive my car. I didn't think I'd be able to drive today.
